title: Entergy Arkansas announces temporary suspension of disconnects during extreme heat
summary: To help customers remain safe and comfortable during this period of extreme heat, disconnects are suspended until at least Aug. 24.
body_markdown:
With extreme summer heat continuing across Arkansas, we want to share a few simple steps to help you stay safe, comfortable and in control of your energy costs.


**Temporary suspension of disconnects**
To help customers remain safe and comfortable during this period of extreme heat, disconnects are suspended until at least


**Aug. 24** .


**Stay safe in the heat**
Whether you’re working outdoors, doing yardwork or tackling home projects, remember to:


- Drink plenty of water and stay hydrated.


- Take regular breaks in a cool or shaded area.


- Schedule strenuous outdoor activities during the coolest parts of the day when possible.


- Pay attention to signs of heat exhaustion, including extreme weakness, fatigue, nausea, headache and heavy sweating.


- Heat stroke can be life-threatening. If someone experiences confusion, loss of consciousness, seizures or hot, dry skin, move them to a cool area and seek immediate medical assistance.


**Simple ways to save energy**
Cooling your home can account for a significant portion of your electric bill during the summer. A few low- or no-cost changes can help:


- Set your thermostat to the highest temperature that’s comfortable.


- Change or clean your air-conditioning filter regularly.


- Use ceiling or portable fans to circulate cool air, and turn fans off when rooms are unoccupied.


- Close blinds, shades and curtains during the hottest parts of the day.


- Seal gaps around doors, windows and ductwork to keep cool air inside.


- Use your


[myAdvisor](https://billtoolkit.entergy.com/arkansas/help-lowering/myadvisor/) tools through your


[myEntergy](https://www.myentergy.com/s/login/?_gl=1*1v9b2dz*_gcl_aw*R0NMLjE3Nzk0NjExNzEuQ2owS0NRandfYl9RQmhDU0FSSXNBUDZoUjRkQURwNmdPVlBpaWNoaklHSENqWWI2akFPYl9Md1FRZXFQaHNKRTZQczVLOWhmWktIZFpVb2FBcmVmRUFMd193Y0I.*_gcl_au*MTExOTEwOTExNy4xNzgyODQ4NTI2*_ga*MjA5ODA4NzAzLjE3NzM4NTY5NTc.*_ga_4CB8RDLGDZ*czE3ODY1NjA4NTAkbzEzNiRnMSR0MTc4NjU2MjQ2NCRqNTAkbDAkaDA.) account to monitor your energy use and identify opportunities to save.

[myEntergy](https://www.myentergy.com/s/login/?_gl=1*hq6afr*_gcl_aw*R0NMLjE3Nzk0NjExNzEuQ2owS0NRandfYl9RQmhDU0FSSXNBUDZoUjRkQURwNmdPVlBpaWNoaklHSENqWWI2akFPYl9Md1FRZXFQaHNKRTZQczVLOWhmWktIZFpVb2FBcmVmRUFMd193Y0I.*_gcl_au*MTExOTEwOTExNy4xNzgyODQ4NTI2*_ga*MjA5ODA4NzAzLjE3NzM4NTY5NTc.*_ga_4CB8RDLGDZ*czE3ODY1NjA4NTAkbzEzNiRnMSR0MTc4NjU2MjYyMSRqNjAkbDAkaDA.) account or call 1-800-9OUTAGE.


We appreciate your partnership as we work to keep you safe, comfortable and powered through the summer.
